==Description==
The '''Demoman''' is a narrator that appears in [[Story Mode|Story]] mode.

He is the [[Demoman]] tower as a narrator.

==Appearance==
{{Tabber
|Current
|The '''Demoman''' takes the appearance of the Level 0 [[Demoman]]. He has dark skin, a grey shirt and pants, and a black vest, hat and shoes. 

It holds a grenade in all of its animations.

|Version 1
|The '''Demoman''' takes the appearance of the Level 0 [[Demoman]]. He has dark skin, a grey shirt and pants, and a black vest, hat and shoes. However, unlike the regular [[Demoman]], it has destroyed clothes, with a portion of its vest being cut off and its sleeves being tattered.

It holds a grenade in all of its animations.
}}
